ABSTRACT 
A tool comprising a receptacle for receiving and holding a 
cable terminating assembly comprising a plurality of con 
ductors and a plurality of piercing contacts , the tool com 
prising a pair of handles which actuate opposed presses and 
blades , the presses pushing the piercing contacts into the 
conductors while the blades trim the ends of the conductors .

ABSTRACT 
A tool comprising a receptacle for receiving and holding a 
cable terminating assembly comprising a plurality of con 
ductors and a plurality of piercing contacts , the tool com 
prising a pair of handles which actuate opposed presses and 
blades , the presses pushing the piercing contacts into the 
conductors while the blades trim the ends of the conductors .
